1. (Currently amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, __wherein the escalated alarm is perceptibly different from the first alarm__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer, __and wherein acknowledgment of the second alarm prevents transmission of the output to initiate the escalated alarm__.

3. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm.

4. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

5. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm.

6. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously.

7. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system.

16. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to track escalation status; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, __and escalation status information__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, __wherein the alarm data is distinct from general system log data and is specifically associated with alarm events__.
